title: LENGTH (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT {fn LENGTH(7.00)} AS CharCount, {fn LENGTH(+007)} AS CharCount, {fn LENGTH(007.)} AS CharCount, {fn LENGTH(00000.00)} AS CharCount, {fn LENGTH(-0)} AS CharCount
SELECT LENGTH(0.7) AS CharCount, LENGTH('0.7') AS CharCount
SELECT LENGTH(' INTERSYSTEMS ') AS CharCount, LENGTH(LTRIM(' INTERSYSTEMS ')) AS CharCount
SELECT Name,{fn LENGTH(Name)} AS CharCount FROM Sample.Person ORDER BY CharCount
SELECT DOB,{fn LENGTH(DOB)} AS LenCount, CHAR_LENGTH(DOB) AS CCount, CHARACTER_LENGTH(DOB) AS CtrCount FROM Sample.Person
